events.detail: 6 current official East Anglia residential, marine, coastal-land and leasehold records were captured.
Exact title and postcode repository searches returned no indexed match for all 6 wave-96 candidates.
Existing use was separated from coastal erosion, alternative-use consent, historic rent and lease-cost risks.
Wave-96 rows were published with source-hash, parcel, geometry and promotion gates preserved.
6 current official amenity-land, country-house, short-lease and configuration-risk records were captured.
Exact title and postcode repository searches returned no indexed match for all 6 wave-97 candidates.
Existing use was separated from no-current-consent land, short lease, incomplete extract and lawful-configuration requirements.
Wave-97 rows were published with lease, title, planning and safety warnings visible.
6 current official duplex, permissioned development, hotel conversion and refurbishment records were captured.
Exact title and postcode repository searches returned no indexed match for all 6 wave-98 candidates.
Current permissions were separated from conditions, validity, service, structural and financeability verification.
Wave-98 rows were published with canonical runtime and product-promotion gates preserved.
6 current official residential, two-flat income, former campsite and listed-commercial records were captured.
Exact title and postcode repository searches returned no indexed match for all 6 wave-99 candidates.
Current rent was separated from lawful configuration, campsite consent, coastal risk and listed-building obligations.
Wave-99 rows were published with all safety and promotion gates preserved.
6 current official residential, STPP land and former-care-facility records were captured.
Exact title and postcode repository searches returned no indexed match for all 6 wave-100 candidates.
Existing use was separated from STPP development, HMO/flat-conversion consent and incomplete official extracts.
Wave-100 rows were published with all safety, source-hash, parcel, geometry and promotion gates preserved.
Missing DOM proof was classified as external_blocked rather than an indefinitely running pending task; ownership was not claimed.
The web loader was changed from all-or-nothing required loading to bounded partial loading with failed-file reporting and a 15-second watchdog.
